# ClientNode v6 Upstream Fixtures

`upstream.hex` is generated by
[`tools/fixtures/client-node-v6/generate.c`](/tools/fixtures/client-node-v6/generate.c)
with the PipeWire SPA C builders. The source is the upstream
[PipeWire commit `30ff8da174121567c06a576bf2a83e71779ee991`](https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/pipewire/pipewire/-/commit/30ff8da174121567c06a576bf2a83e71779ee991).
The generator uses headers under `spa/include` and reproduces the field
sequences in `src/modules/module-client-node/protocol-native.c` at that commit.
The canonical local source archive is
`/home/rektide/archive/pipewire/pipewire`. The tool does not link to or call
this project's Rust codecs.

From the repository root, reproduce and verify the fixture with an exact
PipeWire checkout:

```sh
git -C /path/to/pipewire checkout 30ff8da174121567c06a576bf2a83e71779ee991
tools/fixtures/client-node-v6/generate.sh /path/to/pipewire \
  > /tmp/client-node-v6-upstream.hex
cmp protocol/tests/fixtures/client-node-v6/upstream.hex \
  /tmp/client-node-v6-upstream.hex
```

The script verifies `HEAD`, then builds with
`cc -D_GNU_SOURCE -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -O2
-I/path/to/pipewire/spa/include` and runs the resulting temporary executable.
A successful `cmp` produces no output.

SPA POD scalar fields use host byte order. The checked-in vectors were produced
on a little-endian x86_64 host; generation on a big-endian host intentionally
will not match them. The vectors cover `Update`,
`PortUpdate`, both `SetActive` values, `Transport`, `PortSetParam`,
`PortUseBuffers`, `PortSetIo`, `SetActivation`, and the exact SPA Node Start
command object. `format-s16le-48k-stereo` is produced by
`spa_format_audio_raw_build` with S16LE, 48000 Hz, FL/FR stereo; the same exact
object appears in `port-update` and `port-set-param`.

Sentinels are intentional: `mix_id` is `SPA_ID_INVALID` in buffer and IO
fixtures, while FD indices are frame-local `0`/`1`. Clear sentinel vectors are
covered separately by codec tests because they contain no semantic media POD.
